programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Unlike the countless Show & Shine car meetings, at the Rust'n'Roll the older means the better. Only when the vehicles look really old and are as rusty as possible are they considered beautiful.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The NitrolympX is a motor sport event that was first held in Hockenheim in 1986. With about 30,000 spectators and around 300 participants, it is the largest international drag race event in Europe.

programme.title: A tuned Beetle!
programme.desc: It looks like a Volkswagen Beetle from the Seventies. But with contemporary tuning, 90 horse power and 112 mph top speed, it promises unlimited driving pleasure.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We took the Ferrari 458 Italia for a spring ride around Lake Starnberg. Also: a test drive of BMW's 6 series convertible at the Table Mountain in South Africa. And: the Chevrolet Orlando family van.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Audi built only 333 units of its GT model. We tested the everyday use compatibility of the R8 GT. In addition: the Mazda MX5, the most popular roadster in the world. And: the Mercedes-AMG GT3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: More efficiency, less weight and more sportiness is what Audi promotes in order to win the race against BMW and Mercedes with their A6 2.0 TDI. Also: Patrick Dempsey and his racing team at the Grand Am Rolex Sportscar GT series.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Racing has been a matter of the heart for Ford for over 100 years. Henry Ford already wins the first race with his first car. Thousands of other victories were to follow.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The development of engineering at BMW has always been closely linked to motorsport. Racing has always played a decisive role in shaping the brand and setting the pace for its future.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: In the 1980s and 90s, Porsche races from victory to victory. A McLaren with Porsche engine wins the Formula 1 World Championship three times. In Le Mans in 1982, Porsche starts an unbelievable winning streak with the new 956/962 prototype.

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: The Glas GT looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the province of Lower Bavaria in Germany. In the early 1960s it was one of the few German sports cars.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16
programme.desc: Peugeot released this classic, all wheel drive monster for one purpose only: It should bring the World Rally Championship to France. The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 shook up the rally world in the 80s.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In a race between a dump truck and a car, man and machine are brought to their limits. Stuntman Stefan receives a load of gravel for his birthday, instead of confetti.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Normal is not enough. Tuning is a way of life for many car fans - the search for ever more horsepower, better sound and extraordinary design.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Monza Rally Show is a classic among drift shows. Plus: a Mercedes G-Class becomes a special off-roader 'ORC Bull'. And: a Mini Countryman becomes a Dakar Rally competitor.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Porsche is like a religion! The faiths: Punk, technology and racing. Porsche punk Magnus Walker preaches individualism for historic vehicles. Technology has been embodied by Alois RUF since 1983. And for the racers, there is the GT3 RS.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: BMW tries to combine the electric future with fuel-saving features in the i8. In addition: the 'Race Chip' is tested on a 3,000-kilometre route. And: What is the benefit of the switchable performance enhancement from DTE Systems?

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: They are the US car icons par excellence: Chevy, Ford Mustang and Corvette. At Race 61, fans of historic racers pay homage to their heroes. And: we explore the history of the Ford Mustang up to the current model.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Ken Block - Gymkhana Grid
programme.desc: Spectacular drifts are to be expected when Ken Block visits the Gymkhana Grid.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Röhrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the 1930s the famous Silver Arrows by Auto Union that were designed by Ferdinand Porsche celebrated great successes at the European Drivers' Championship and several Grand Prix races despite the strong competition by Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The International Championship for Manufacturers was a rally series which was run from 1970 to 1972. Car manufacturers such as Porsche, Renault, Opel and Ford took part in this competition, with Ford having an exceptionally successful year in 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Lightweight
programme.desc: An iconic racing car and one of only 29 ever built! We accompanied the Mercedes 300 SL 'lightweight' on its premiere drive at the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: The long version of the Bentley Mulsanne is a prime example of a chauffeured limousine. With it, the British luxury car brand has set the bar extremely high when it comes to automotive comfort.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: Arabella Classics
programme.desc: Rare Automobiles and stunning views! The Arabella Classics, one of the most exclusive Classic Car Rallies in Europe.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode features Action Concept's stunt highlights from all previous specials, from exciting car stunts to meticulously choreographed fight scenes and even some snowmobile shootout action.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This time, an industrial site is the scene for the stunt extravaganza. The Stunt Heroes' objective: jump through a truck trailer with a car. As usual with such risky car stunts, careful planning, preparation, timing and precision are of the essence.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In a race between a dump truck and a car, man and machine are brought to their limits. Stuntman Stefan receives a load of gravel for his birthday, instead of confetti.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: The Audi S8 Plus is by no means underpowered, but it is and remains faithful to this model series' understatement. Those who want more power can get a boost from MTM.

programme.title: Ferrari California T
programme.desc: The Ferrari California T has a lot of Italian passion and elegant lines to offer. Super sports car cabriolets are popular all over the world. It is no wonder that more and more manufacturers are 'opening up'.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Die-hard Porsche fan Marco Wendlandt makes his dream come true: driving a 1984 Porsche 911 coupe. With the help from Big Mike, a car dealer from Los Angeles, he tracks down the car in San Francisco.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: With his newly bought Porsche 911 coupe, Marco heads to L.A. to meet one of the best known Porsche enthusiasts of the world: Magnus Walker, who invites Marco to visit his workshop and his collection.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: On his way to Las Vegas Marco drops by Big Mike in the Apple Valley. Together they meet Big Mike's friends from the Kustos family, who once used to be trendsetters in the Californian car customizing scene.

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The fourth race of the VLN season is usually regarded as a dress rehearsal for the 24-hour race. For the top teams and best drivers it is the last opportunity for a really thorough test.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: We present the highlights of last week. The 24 hour race was exciting, as usual. In addition, we explored the 'Strong Man Run' and took a look at the tourist drivers

programme.title: BMW 503
programme.desc: The noble four-seater 503 convertible was one of BMWs most exclusive models in the 1950s. Many international sports and movie stars and other wealthy customers were fond of this sporty luxury vehicle.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: It looks sportier than one might expect from the Swedes. The taillights frame the powerful looking rear. On the inside, the Volvo S90 impresses with the finest materials and soft nappa leather.

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Small City Cars
programme.desc: Small city cars reflect the change of times in regards to new technology and eco-awareness. In 2023, Mitsubishi presented the ASX as a hybrid. And: 40 years of Opel Corsa. We show its transformation from city car to urban e-vehicle.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: For decades, upper mid-range sedans have stood for the ideal combination of luxury, technology, and performance, especially for families and long distance travels. We put the hybrid Mercedes E 300 e and the fully electric VW ID.7 to the test.

programme.title: Vive la Evolution
programme.desc: For decades, French cars have combined extravagant design and innovation. The DS brand represents luxury and cutting-edge technology from Citroen. Does this also apply to the DS4? And: we tested the Peugeot 408 crossover SUV in Spain.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Seat Ibiza turns 40 and we take a look back at the successes and highlights of this small car. And the big comparison: Mitsubishi ASX competes against its sister models Nissan Juke and Renault Captur. Which is better?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Cars from Asia are successful worldwide and there is an enormous variety. The Subaru BRZ with 234 hp and incredible handling offers adrenaline rushes at a low price. And: how good is the new Mitsubishi Colt compared to the competition?

programme.title: Has engine-tuner AMG reached the end of the road? What can be pimped in the electric AMG EQE 53?
programme.desc: Mercedes in-house tuner AMG has taken the electric E-Class EQE under its wing and unleashes the EQE 53 with 687 hp peak power. An impressive 1000 newtonmeters of maximum torque catapults the electric AMG to 100 km/h in just 3.3 seconds.

programme.title: Maserati Levante S
programme.desc: The Levante aims to be not just a Maserati SUV, but 'the Maserati of SUVs'.

programme.title: The Camaro 50th Anniversary Edition
programme.desc: 50 years of the Chevrolet Camaro. The American brand is celebrating with a special model with 453 hp. We tested the coupé in the foothills of the Alps.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: LDV takes aim at the seven-seater SUV segment with the D90. The Renault Trafic makes a welcome return to the local van segment and Gugu gets better acquainted with the BYD Atto 8.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: The team compares the Mercedes-Benz GLC and Audi Q5 as used premium SUVs, examines whether an out-of-warranty Ranger with a wet belt is worth keeping, and asks when it's finally time to replace a high-mileage workhorse.

programme.title: Garage Gold
programme.desc: We go off-road with a bunch of Ford Model Ts and explore some of the best Nissan and Datsun models in South Africa.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: The team heads down to George to check out some classic gems. KZN proves bikers can do burnouts too and we meet up with some speed freaks who have a passion for drag racing.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A trend is on the rise: going on mountain cruises in a sports car. As super cars become more comfortable and suitable for travelling in spite of their ever-increasing performance, what would be the perfect sports car for taking on the Alps: the Lamborghini Aventador Miura Homage, the Ferrari 458 Speciale, the McLaren 570S or the Porsche 911 Turbo S?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To drive or be driven: That is the question for people who can afford such a choice. When it comes to the Bentley Mulsanne with its extended wheelbase, one could be more delighted to sit in the back of the car than in the front. But what is the situation when it comes to the sporty Maserati Quattroporte? Or the upgraded BMW 7 series by Alpina with the model name B7? Or the original, the BMW 750i?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Would you prefer a turbocharged or rather a naturally aspirated engine? With the 7th generation Chevrolet Corvette, buyers were able to choose between either. What's the more convincing model variation, the Grand Sport or Z06? Also: the McLaren 720, with its 4-litre BiTurbo V8. And: taking part in the "Bavaria Sportwagen Tour" with an AMG GTR.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: If you had the choice to select three cars for every occasion, which models would receive a spot in your garage? We took a look at the Rolls Royce Phantom, the Aston Martin DBS Superleggera and the Audi RS4 for this little mindgame.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: In 2018, the Audi R8 Quattro Performance received an upgrade. The new version shared some of its aerodynamic features with the Lamborghini Huracan. Also: the Porsche Macan S got a more powerful engine.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The rebirth of French chic: the elegant DS 9 from Citroen's luxury brand. Plus: the Genesis GV80 offers luxury at a low price. And: a test drive in the exorbitantly expensive Mercedes-Benz 300 SL.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: LDV takes aim at the seven-seater SUV segment with the D90. The Renault Trafic makes a welcome return to the local van segment and Gugu gets better acquainted with the BYD Atto 8.

programme.title: Volvo S90

programme.title: Alfa Romeo 6C 2500SS
programme.desc: Founded in 1910, the iconic Italian car manufacturer Alfa Romeo experienced a very eventful history. Their 6C 2500 SS model is right in the middle of the company's more than 100-year history. It combined new technology with an early post-war appearance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the GTR, Nissan tried to take on the established European sports car manufacturers. For less than half the price the GTR was a more affordable direct competitor to Porsche's 911 Turbo S or the Audi R8 GT. In addition: one of the ultimate super cars, the Techart 911 Turbo S with 620 hp. And: the Pagani Huayra, presented and driven by Formula 1 Pilot Adrian Sutil.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: It's not always a car's pure power that makes driving through curves exciting. The Subaru BRZ with its low boxer engine and its well-balanced handling gives his driver a very good feeling for the road. The BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance and the Porsche Cayman GTS with its mid-engine puts a smile on your face as soon as you put your foot on the accelerator.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the creation of its i8, Munich-based car manufacturer BMW makes a big step towards the future. After all, the futuristic looking car is the first German sports car which utilizes hybrid technology. Supercars checks out the BMW i8 on the streets of Los Angeles. But BMW did not just work on the i8. They also present the new sports coupe 435i and the sporty SUV X550d M.

programme.title: UFA 359 - Up Next Fighting (UNF) 9 Part 2 - Lilley vs. Strader
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 9 part 2 from Southern California. In this episode after a confrontational weigh in Jesse Strader faces Ryan Lilley in the featured bout. Also watch Jake Babian versus Emanuel Graham, Weston Quiroz looks to take the title from featherweight reigning champion Hamzeh Trad and in a bantamweight contest David Duran fights Narek Avaguan.

programme.title: UFA 425 - Red Owl BoxFest XIV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XIV part 1 from Houston, Texas. This episode kicks off with a female Superweight bout between Gabriela Tellez and Lindsey Ellis. In the main event undefeated Deonte Brown with a 15-0 record is coming off a three year layoff to take on the tough veteran Dennis Contreras with a 24-17 record.

programme.title: UFA 429 - Red Owl BoxFest XIV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XIV part 2 from Houston, Texas. Watch as Alex Dionis the hometown favorite makes his pro-debut against Andrew Flamm and in the main event Javier Martinez takes on Wayne Lawrence in a six round super-lightweight match.

programme.title: UFA 501 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. This episode features the semi-final matchups in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament with Vasile Corcodel facing Sebastian Lutaniuc and Becali Bodescu taking on Aaron Măcăilă. Next up is a Super Fight lighetweight match between Denisa Vulpe from Romania and Maria Chișcă of Maldova. In another Super Fight bout, Spain's Bubu Ndow steps into the ring with Romanian Andrei Leuștean.

programme.title: UFA 502 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 The Battle of Moldova from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. Starting off is a Superfight in the lightweight division between Emi Lupașcu and Damir Popovici followed by a Suprfight in the Super Middleweight division with Tudor Potoroacă versus Francesco Carbotti. This episode also features the Championship matchup in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament, the winner will move on to comptete in the World Grand Prix in Japan. In the main event is Florin Lambagiu versus Cristian Ristea - it's the Gladiator versus Rambo with 40 knockouts betweeen them facing off in a Superfight in the open weight division.

programme.title: UFA 485 - Clan Wars 54 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Kevin Walsh steps into the cage with Nate Kelly the defending flyweight champion with the title on the line while Simon Sackey faces Jonny Ward and Aaron Henry takes on Kian McCarton. In the co-main event Mick McBride and Shivraj Patil look to trade punches in the cage.

programme.title: UFA 486 - Clan Wars 54 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up, in a female bout, Alexa Padugan squares off against Gemma Coghill in a rematch. Followed by Billy Sutherland and Jean Bernard Kamali in another rematch in the Clan Wars cage. Next up in the welterweight division, Kyle Paton faces "Lethal" Shea Leathem and in the main event, Bobby Smith and Chris Boyd take to the cage for what's expexted to be an explosive matchup.

programme.title: UFA 364 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 part 1 from London. Up first in a cruiser weight contest, England's Martyn Grainger steps into the ring with Szymon Szynkiewicz of Poland followed by Ryan McCann versus Dean Morris in a featherweight bout. Also John Collier takes on Jonny Lawson with 16 BKB fights under his belt and in a superweight title clash Danylo Hrebenuyk and undefeated Matty Moore touch gloves.

programme.title: UFA 365 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 34 part 2 from London. In this episode Tony Barratt takes on Craig Griffiths in a heavyweight BKB contest, in the women's division Mathilda Wilson faces Lailane Mota in a Swedish versus Brazil clash. Watch as experienced MMA fighter George Hillyard and MMA legend Rolando Gabriel Dy step into the ring while Pat Nash takes on Lee Spencer. With the British Featherweight Title up for grabs, Reece Murray and Martin Reffell battle for the belt. In the main event, Aaron McCallum and Mark Tiffin are set to meet the challenge with the bantamweight title on the line.

programme.title: UFA 347 - Up Next Fighting (UNF) 9 Part 1 - Rivera vs. Wang-Kim
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 9 from Southern California. In a heavyweight bout Sean Sharaf takes on Nathan Mullett and Anthony Romero faces Brandon Aviles. The main event features a title fight between Cisco Rivera with 10 KO's and Contender Series Josh Wang Kim in the bantamweight division.

programme.title: UFA 372 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 1 from Romania. Watch as Andrei Varga "The Bonecrusher" faces Adrian Maxim in a youth versus expierence bout where the winner will move on in the tournament. Also fighting to stay in the tournament are Darius Argyo and Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru ("Berzerk") and Marian Lapusneanu ("The Terror") and in the fourth quarterfinal fight Costel Schiopu versus Alex Bublea.

programme.title: UFA 373 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 2 from Romania. The quarterfinalist winners move on to fight in the championship tournament. The tournament fighters are Andrei Varga v Adrian Maxim, Darius Argyo v Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru v Marian Lapusneanu, Costel Schiopu v Alex Bublea. Also in this episode, a heavyweight fight between Brian Douwes and Ionut Iancu while Omar Ezekiel Moreno and Andrei Ostrovanu vie for the ISKA Super Middleweight Championship Title.

programme.title: UFA 383 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 1 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. First up with the kickboxing action are the young Marciano Aerts facing the more experienced Vasile Cotelea, undefeated Paul Danci steps into the ring with David Anton while in the cruiserweight division Marius Rotaru and Ionut Busuioc face off.

programme.title: UFA 384 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 2 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. In this episode fighters Andrei Leustean, Costin Dinu, Alexandru Andreescu and Andrei Ostrovanu battle for the title in a four man light heavyweight tournament. Also watch Andrei Varga and Bogdan Suru take to the ring for a much anticipated kickboxing contest.

programme.title: UFA 385 - Dynamite Fighting Show 23 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 23 "Descendant's of Dracula" part 3 from Bistrita, Romania, the gateway of Transylvania. In this episode, Sandor Kertesz faces Marius Munteanu in a heavyweight kickboxing match while veteran fighters Alex Bublea, with 93 wins, takes on Calin Petrisor with 37 wins. In an ISKA intercontinental Title fight in the lightweight division, Morocco's Odris Ramzi takes on Romania's Ionut Popa for the belt. Also in this episode, Balazs Kiss is matched up against Sebastian Lutaniuc in the cruiserweight division.

programme.title: UFA 402 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 1 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features an 8 man tournament in the cruiserweight division. The champion will face the challenger in the ISKA world cruiserweight championship. Fighting in the quarter finals are Alessio Sarbu vs Sebastian Lutaniuc, Becali Bodescu vs Marius Rotaru, Costi Mocany vs Danut Hurduc and Alex Virlan vs Ionut Busuioc.

programme.title: UFA 403 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 2 from Targu Jiu, Romania. Continuining the 8 man tournament in the crusierweight division, this episode features the semi-finals. In a SuperFight open weight division bout Vajtan Shanava, Spanish champion for three consecutive years, steps into the ring with Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi, Romanian favorite with a record of 62 wins and 31 by KO.

programme.title: UFA 404 - Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 24 part 3 from Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features the 8 man tournament final for the DFS crusierweight belt. But first, stepping into the ring are Alexandros Chrysochoidis and Bogdan Nastase with 55 victories, face off in a Superfight in the light heavyweight division. Next up two champions, Calin Petrisor, the defending ISKA champion and Valentin Mavrodin the defending DFS champion take to the ring for a title fight with the ISKA and DFS belt unificaiton on the line in the middleweight division.

programme.title: UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: UFA 430- Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 1 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. Up first in the middle weight division Denis Ceausu faces Andrei Varga. In the open weight division with a huge weight differential Rodrigo Mineiro, kickboxing world champion takes on boxer Bogdan Bestea for a boxing versus kickboxing contest. Watch as Alex Leautaund of the Netherlands takes on Romania's Mihai Desrobitu in a cruiserweight boxing bout.

programme.title: UFA 433 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 2 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of fights. First up, a Superfight in the welterweight division, Bogdan Floristean versus Ionel Balan. In the women's lightweight division Maria Nitescu takes on Andreea Cebuc to determine the Baddest Woman in Romania. Also on this episode in the open division Tibor Varga of Hungary steps into the ring with Romania's Bogdan Nastase in a David versus Goliath duel.

programme.title: UFA 437 - Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 26 part 3 from the Traian Aena in Râmnicu Vâlcea, Romania for a great night of boxing and kickboxing fights. In the welterweight division Vinicius Bereta takes on Valentin Mavrodin in a Brazil versus Romania bout. In the open weight division Tolea Ciumac steps into the ring with Valentin Lambagiu with 100 pounds and over 20 years difference between the two fighters for a David versus Goliath duel. In the main event, Portugal's Iuri Fernandes faces Romania's Bogdan Stoica, with a stunning 58 wins to his name, in the Heavyweight division.

programme.title: UFA 456 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 1 from Transylvania, Romania. Starting off with a superfight in the lightweight division, Bogdan Floristean faces Ionut Popa and in the middleweight division, Dominik Horvath takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga. Also stepping into the cage are Brazilian Rodrigo Mineiro and Romanian Florin Lambagiu.

programme.title: UFA 458 - Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 27 part 2 from Transylvania, Romania. In this episode Fernando Martin from Spain and Romania's Andrei Leustean face off in a super middleweight division bout. Next up the co-main event in the heavyweight division, Hungary's Sandor Kertesz takes on Romania's Bogan Stoica. In the main event USA's Omar Moreno steps into the ring with hometown favorite Andrei Ostravanu for a rematch in a supermiddleweight fight.

programme.title: UFA 468 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 1 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up in the light-heavyweight division, undefeated Paul Danci takes on Alex Andreescu. Next up undefeated Eric Bubuleandra versus Becali Bodescu face off in the cruiser-weight division. In a heavyweight bout Bogdan Besta steps into the ring with Vasile Corcodel who looks to remain undefeated against his significantly heavier opponent. The main event features a super-cruiserweight bout between Italy's Frank Kanate and Romania's Stean Latescu.

programme.title: UFA 469 - Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 28 part 2 from the Sala Polivalentă BT Arena in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. First up, a bout in the cruiserweight division with Madalin Mogos versus Sebastian Lutaniuc. Achilles Karapiperis and Calin Petrisor "The KO Hunter" step into the ring to face off in a middleweight division fight. In an open weight entertainment fight Justitiarul De Berceni makes his professional debut against veteran fighter Tolea Ciumac "The Tiberian Bear." In the co-main event Netherland's Chris Baya faces Romania's Florin Lambagiu in a supermiddleweight division fight.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.title: UFA 350 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. Starting off in the heavyweight division, Poland's Dominik Jedrejczyk takes on Romania's Claudiu Badoi in a David versus Goliath fight. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: UFA 372 - Dynamite Fighting Show 22 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 22 part 1 from Romania. Watch as Andrei Varga "The Bonecrusher" faces Adrian Maxim in a youth versus expierence bout where the winner will move on in the tournament. Also fighting to stay in the tournament are Darius Argyo and Valentin Mavrodin, Marius Cimpoieru ("Berzerk") and Marian Lapusneanu ("The Terror") and in the fourth quarterfinal fight Costel Schiopu versus Alex Bublea.

programme.title: UFA 499 - UFA’s Baddest Babes – Best of part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Best of Baddest Babes part 2 with an action-packed episode featuring all female fighters showcasing the skill, strength and personalities of women redefining the world of combat sports. Bouts include SFT: Camila Santos versus Ruth Ravena, Breakthrough MMA: Caitlin Sammons versus Jessica Borga, TuffNUff MMA: Jessica Branco versus Cheyanne Vlismas, SFT: Gisele Moreira versus Daiane Firmino,CFL: Maraya Miller versus Alenita Perez, TuffNUff: Brieta Carpenter versus Serena DeJesus and Ronda Rousey versus Autumn Richardson.

programme.title: UFA 390 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 1 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Starting off in the lightweight division Filip "El Capitan" Lindgren from Stockholm faces hometown favorite Noak Wollsater in a rematch. In the female division, watch as two time Swedish kickboxing champion Joanna Camacho gets into the ring with Janet Kling, two time Swedish Muay Thai silver medalist while Oscar Lindkvist and Simon Vinterskog from rival gyms take to the ring. Also tonight Peter Wallin, K1 champion, takes on Andreas Hall in the light heavyweight division.

programme.title: UFA 391 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 2 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Starting off this episode in the middleweight division Cedrik Von Heiroth faces opponent Viktor Schiller. In a female bout, Ewin Ates and Lisa Larsson both with no defeats take to the ring and Sam Wingqvist is matched up against Sam Ghoroghi in a lightweight match.

programme.title: UFA 392 - Muay Thai For Life 8 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Muay Thai for Life 8.0 part 3 from Sweden at the Rondo Liseberg Center. Buckle up for a brawl in the super heavyweight division as Swedish Muay Thai champion Mattias Lundkvist takes on Zvonimir Kralj "The Croatian Sensation." Also on this episode Alexander Jansson faces Muay Thai champ Poramin Atsa in a middle weight bout while in the co-main event, Colombia's Nico Sanabria takes on Amir El-Dakkak. In the main event Denmark's Youssef Assouik, multiple World Champion, takes on Anton Sjoqvist, Muay Thai World Champion from Stockholm in the super middleweight division.

programme.title: UFA 502 - Dynamite Fighting Show 32 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 The Battle of Moldova from the Sala Polivalentă in Iași, Romania. Starting off is a Superfight in the lightweight division between Emi Lupașcu and Damir Popovici followed by a Suprfight in the Super Middleweight division with Tudor Potoroacă versus Francesco Carbotti. This episode also features the Championship matchup in the DFS - K1 90 kilo World Grand Prix tournament, the winner will move on to comptete in the World Grand Prix in Japan. In the main event is Florin Lambagiu versus Cristian Ristea - it's the Gladiator versus Rambo with 40 knockouts betweeen them facing off in a Superfight in the open weight division.

programme.title: UFA 488 - Fighters Only 17th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.desc: The NCPA Nationals reach a fever pitch in Saint Louis as the University of Arizona Wildcats and the CU Boulder Buffaloes go head-to-head in a high-stakes, best-of-seven showdown. This elite showcase features "smash mouth" pickleball, where powerhouses like Eileen Tran and Frida Madsen utilize aggressive "Skills" to dominate the kitchen line. The intensity explodes during the "Racing" pace of sudden-death points, forcing competitors into a tactical "Freestyle" battle of wills as they navigate a tight center court with no room for error. programme.desc: Experience the thrilling showdown at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships as twin brothers Hunter Johnson and Yates Johnson face off for the very first time in the men's pro singles gold medal match. Both top seeds with years of experience playing doubles together, these brothers bring a unique dynamic filled with expert strategy, rapid exchanges, and emotional rivalry. From early leads and tactical shot-making to late-game drama and camaraderie, watch Hunter and Yates battle it out point by point in a historic and captivating final. Featuring expert commentary and insights into their playing styles, this match is a must-watch for pickleball fans everywhere.

programme.title: Men's Singles Open Final - Chaudry vs. Karbownik
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Pune - Day 8 Tie 2
programme.desc: Step into the electric Jio World Garden in Mumbai for a high-stakes showdown where the road to the playoffs is on the line. Delhi Dilwale enter this tie in second place, looking to solidify their dominance and secure a "Q" next to their name for a guaranteed spot in the semifinals. On the other side, Pune United are fighting for survival, desperately needing a win after finally breaking their season-long drought earlier in the day. Witness intense matchups as tactical veterans like Trang Huynh and Max Mansoor face off against Pune's resilient stars, including the grit of Katie Morris and the power of William Sobeck. programme.title: NCPA Virginia Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UVA vs. High Point
programme.desc: Live from Virginia Beach at the NCPA Virginia Regional 2025, the University of Virginia (UVA) faces off against High Point University in a crucial pool play match. With a bid to the National Championship in St. Louis on the line, these teams battle through a best-of-seven format.The episode kicks off with Women's Singles featuring Alexandra McDonald (UVA) and Sushi Bandaru (High Point), followed by an intense Men's Singles showdown between Eric Lee (UVA) and High Point's wild card, Freddy Ortmann. The action heats up in Men's Doubles with Cooper Duncan joining Ortmann, and Aiden Eggleston partnering with Lee. Watch for strategic mixed doubles play and see if High Point can force a sudden death dreambreaker.

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Florida Super Regional 2024 - Kennesaw State University vs. Georgia Tech
programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes intensity of a "Battle for the Bid" at the 2024 DUPR Florida Super Regional in Port Saint Lucie. This match pits the seasoned Kennesaw State Owls against a surprising Georgia Tech squad that is brand new to the tournament scene. Despite Kennesaw entering as the heavy 80% statistical favorite, the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets delivered a stunning wake-up call with a dominant 21–9 victory in Women's Doubles. Now, the Owls must lean on their powerhouse Men’s and Mixed Doubles teams to claw back and keep their championship dreams alive. With a direct invitation to the Collegiate Pickleball Nationals in Dallas on the line, every point is a fight for survival in this premier regional showcase.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
programme.desc: The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball 2023 – AZ PBL Team Match – Gladiators vs Tornadoes

This April 25, 2023 episode of Tuesday Night Pickleball features fast-paced action and strategic plays as both teams battle it out in a pivotal match. With sharp shots, effective communication, and critical moments, the Gladiators and Tornadoes go head-to-head for a thrilling finish. Watch as the teams showcase their pickleball prowess in one of the most exciting events of the AZ PBL season.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UCLA vs. SDSU
programme.desc: Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.
